segments.speaker: Jake
segments.text: Hey, do you have a minute? I want to talk about Mia's surprise party.

segments.speaker: Sara
segments.text: Sure! I'm excited. Her birthday is next Saturday, right?

segments.speaker: Jake
segments.text: Yes, next Saturday. But I need your help. The plan is a little sketchy right now.

segments.speaker: Sara
segments.text: Sketchy? What do you mean?

segments.speaker: Jake
segments.text: Well, we don't have a place yet, and we don't know who is coming.

segments.speaker: Sara
segments.text: That does sound sketchy. Let's fix it together.

segments.speaker: Jake
segments.text: Okay. First, where should we have the party?

segments.speaker: Sara
segments.text: My apartment is small, but it could work if we don't invite too many people.

segments.speaker: Jake
segments.text: Good idea. Let's keep the guest list under fifteen people.

segments.speaker: Sara
segments.text: That sounds good. Who is on the list so far?

segments.speaker: Jake
segments.text: I already asked her sister, her best friend, and a few coworkers.

segments.speaker: Sara
segments.text: Great. Now we need food and decorations.

segments.speaker: Jake
segments.text: I can order a cake and some snacks. Can you handle the decorations?

segments.speaker: Sara
segments.text: Sure, I'll buy balloons and a banner. It won't take long.

segments.speaker: Jake
segments.text: Perfect. Now, the hardest part is keeping it a secret from Mia.

segments.speaker: Sara
segments.text: That's true. She always asks questions when something feels sketchy.

segments.speaker: Jake
segments.text: Ha, you're right. We need a good excuse to bring her to your apartment.

segments.speaker: Sara
segments.text: Maybe I can invite her for dinner and say it's just the two of us.

segments.speaker: Jake
segments.text: That could work! If everyone hides quietly, we might actually pull it off.

segments.speaker: Sara
segments.text: I hope so. Last year, our friend tried a surprise party, but it was a disaster.

segments.speaker: Jake
segments.text: Yeah, I remember. The lights turned on too early and ruined the surprise.

segments.speaker: Sara
segments.text: Exactly. This time, we need to be on the same page about the timing.

segments.speaker: Jake
segments.text: Agreed. Let's turn off the lights right when she opens the door.

segments.speaker: Sara
segments.text: Perfect. I'll text everyone the plan so we're all on the same page.

segments.speaker: Jake
segments.text: Thanks, Sara. I think we can really pull it off this time.

segments.speaker: Sara
segments.text: Me too. It won't feel sketchy anymore once everything is organized.

segments.speaker: Jake
segments.text: Let's meet again on Thursday to check all the details.

segments.speaker: Sara
segments.text: Sounds good. I'm looking forward to it!
